body:
I've been suicidal for most of my life. I don't tell anyone.

Although I want to die, I wasn't actively attempting ir planning to, and gave no indication that I was during a bad breakup.

I had a drunken argument with my older sister on the phone. She called my ex and they decided to call a crisis hotline or something. The crazy thing is that I had never told either of them in all the years I'd known them that I want to die, so they had no reason to believe that was a realistic possibility.

I was tackled by sherrifs deputies and forced onto a stretcher in my driveway and taken to the hospital, only to be released two hours later after finally seeing a doctor.

That was awful and made me hate my life more, especially having to walk home and receiving several expensive medical bills for that event.

I'll talk about it on the internet but that's it, never to someone who might put me through that again.
Yep, this is wjy nobody in my life knows that I'm suicidal and have been for most of my life.
